verdict.rationale: Motion publishes a pricing page that names tiers (e.g., Business AI), lists included features such as Gantt charts, time tracking, capacity planning, permissions and dashboards, and shows per-seat allotments like 15,000 credits/seat/month, so per-seat tier inclusions are publicly documented. No dollar amount for any tier appears in the evidence, and it does not cover every tier, so the 'exactly what each tier costs' part is unproven. Missing for 10: published per-seat dollar prices for each tier, a complete tier-by-tier inclusion comparison, independent confirmation that pricing is self-serve without a sales call.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-seat pricing tells me exactly what each tier costs and includes before I talk to sales
